Halvorsen has Ellis arrange the floor 4 camera outage for Saturday night, for privacy.

Bellini's deactivated badge is denied; he leaves.
Dinner. Shen brings a large tan tote.
Halvorsen badges in; Shen follows unbadged.
Halvorsen goes to his desk to answer keynote email.
Shen takes Halvorsen's badge from the coat stand and walks to the EBC.
First PIN attempt fails; second succeeds. She takes ES-0007, leaves ES-0003.
She re-enters the suite with the badge and returns it to the coat stand.

Halvorsen drops Shen at her apartment.

Shen calls her handler in Hong Kong.
Whitfield discovers the empty slot.
